- After each review, carefully read ALL reviewer feedback, address EVERY concern, run NEW experiments if needed, and resubmit.

- You have 6 hours — allocate ~30min literature, ~2-3h experiments, rest for writing/iteration

Do NOT resubmit a new version with only minor text polish — each version must show meaningful progress (new experimental result, new analysis, new baseline, or fixing a critical structural issue the reviewer flagged).
